description: This Java source file implements a foreground VPN service called ToyVpnService, which manages VPN connections, handles start/stop actions, manages connection lifecycle (start, connect, disconnect), and shows foreground notifications. It interacts with preferences, handles threading, and maintains VPN interface lifecycle.

classes.name: ToyVpnService
classes.description: Main service class extending VpnService, managing VPN connection lifecycle, user notifications, and thread management for a toy VPN implementation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes handler and configuration intent for the service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start intents to initiate connection or disconnect based on action.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops VPN connection when service is destroyed.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles messages for UI updates via Toast and foreground notification updates.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts a VPN connection, retrieves preferences, and initiates a new ToyVpnConnection.

methods.name: startConnection
methods.description: Starts the VPN connection thread and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: setConnectingThread
methods.description: Sets or interrupts the current connection thread.

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Updates or closes existing VPN connection interfaces.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Stops the VPN connection and removes notifications.

methods.name: updateForegroundNotification
methods.description: Creates or updates the ongoing foreground notification displaying VPN status.
